name: Yahoo Mail Email Provider (dual-mode reference)
author: PrivacyShield
description: Reference email-provider plugin demonstrating BOTH transports in one plugin: OAuth 2.0 (preferred) and SMTP/IMAP with an app-password (fallback). The mode is chosen from the stored credentials. Use it as a template for hybrid providers or to see how SMTP/IMAP and OAuth each work. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
